pre_mortem: It's Monday and both overs lost. Buffalo jumped ahead, Pittsburgh's Broderick Jones-less line could not run, and Warren finished in the 31-yard range while the chase targets went to Metcalf and Austin instead of Gainwell, recreating the 4-yard receiving game. Or the unnamed outdoor weather turned passing into a mess and Gainwell's screens died at the line, while a backup linebacker handled the checkdowns fine so the Bernard angle was empty. That counter is real, which is why Gainwell stays a lean and why nothing is staked without a price, but it is not stronger than the base read: the spread is only 3, Warren has cleared this number three straight weeks, and Buffalo has been the worst run defense in the pack.
slip_story: One story only: a competitive outdoor game in which Pittsburgh can still run and must still throw some, against a Buffalo defense that bleeds rushing yards and is missing Bernard. Warren rush over and Gainwell receiving-yards over win together in that script and in the weather-slog flip. They split if Buffalo blows it open (Gainwell targets up, Warren carries down), so this is not a blowout stack and it is not mixed with a total under or with Buffalo pass overs. Cook, Shakir and Metcalf stay off the slip.
